{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "characters": [
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_ARTIE",
      "display_name": "Artie",
      "role": "protagonist"
    },
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_SYSTEM",
      "display_name": "The System",
      "role": "antagonist_engine"
    },
    {
      "character_id": "CHAR_SILAS",
      "display_name": "Silas the Nullifier",
      "role": "antagonist"
    }
  ],
  "threads": [
    {
      "thread_id": "THREAD_GLITCH",
      "title": "The Glitch Meter",
      "description": "Artie's class instability and the need for rare resources."
    },
    {
      "thread_id": "THREAD_HUNT",
      "title": "The Guild Pursuit",
      "description": "The local and global authorities hunting the anomaly."
    }
  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "Critical Failure to Launch",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Office Space to Outer Space",
          "end_condition": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie's reality dissolves as the System initiates the isekai process.",
              "location_start_label": "Cubicle Farm",
              "location_end_label": "Cubicle Farm",
              "location_start": "Artie's mundane office cubicle.",
              "location_end": "Artie's mundane office cubicle.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The hum of the office air conditioning is the only sound as Artie types his tenth report of the day.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["humming AC", "fluorescent lights", "spreadsheet rows", "clacking keys"],
              "transition_out_text": "The text on the screen begins to bleed into the air, glowing with an eerie blue light.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing text", "digital bleed", "distorted air"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie selects the 'Glitch-Crit' class despite the System's warnings.",
              "location_start_label": "Cubicle Farm",
              "location_end_label": "The Void",
              "location_start": "Artie's mundane office cubicle.",
              "location_end": "The character creation interface.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "The white light fades, leaving Artie suspended in a pitch-black void filled with floating menus.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["pitch-black void", "floating text", "distant digital hum"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_out_text": "A massive red 'WARNING' sign flashes before Artie confirms his choice.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["red warning", "confirmation button", "haptic feedback"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie arrives in the world of Aethelgard with a broken character sheet.",
              "location_start_label": "The Void",
              "location_end_label": "Aethelgard Plains",
              "location_start": "The character creation interface.",
              "location_end": "The grassy plains of the starting zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The void collapses into a swirl of colors as Artie's feet hit solid ground.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["swirling colors", "grass scent", "solid ground"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie looks down at his hands, which are occasionally flickering out of existence.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flickering skin", "low-poly grass", "distant tutorial tower"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Tutorial Bug",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the tutorial arena and meets the Golem.",
              "location_start_label": "Aethelgard Plains",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "The grassy plains of the starting zone.",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A stone gate rumbles open, inviting Artie into the tutorial combat zone.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["stone gate", "rumbling sound", "dust clouds"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_out_text": "The Tutorial Golem rises from the center of the arena, its eyes glowing red.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["rising golem", "red eyes", "scraping stone"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that his attacks deal zero damage unless he hits a 'glitch point'.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The Golem swings a massive stone fist, and Artie barely rolls out of the way.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["stone fist", "dusty roll", "heavy impact"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie notices a flickering purple pixel on the Golem's left knee.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["purple pixel", "visual artifact", "static sound"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie strikes the glitch point, triggering a 1,000,000% damage multiplier.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Lining up his rusty sword, Artie lunges for the flickering purple spot.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rusty sword", "lunge", "focused gaze"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "The world freezes for a microsecond as the System calculates the impossible damage.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["frozen frame", "calculation lag", "white flash"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The Golem explodes into data fragments, ending the tutorial prematurely.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Golem doesn't just fall; it shatters into a million blue cubes that vanish into the air.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue cubes", "shattering stone", "vanishing data"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "A notification chime rings out, sounding more like a car alarm than a victory song.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["alarm chime", "victory window", "empty arena"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Resource Management",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie loots a 'Corrupted Core' from the Golem's remains.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "location_end": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks to the center of the arena where a single, pulsing object remains.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["pulsing object", "arena center", "looting window"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "The core hums in his hand, vibrating with an unstable energy.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["vibrating core", "humming sound", "purple glow"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The System warns Artie that his 'Stability' is at 15% and falling.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Forest Edge",
              "location_start": "A stone-walled combat arena.",
              "location_end": "The edge of the Whispering Woods.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie leaves the arena behind, his character sheet flickering more frequently now.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["flickering sheet", "arena exit", "warning icon"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_out_text": "A scrolling text box informs him that total deletion is imminent without stabilization.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["scrolling text", "deletion warning", "unstable meter"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie learns he needs 'Stability Shards' found in the Whispering Woods.",
              "location_start_label": "Forest Edge",
              "location_end_label": "Forest Edge",
              "location_start": "The edge of the Whispering Woods.",
              "location_end": "The edge of the Whispering Woods.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie opens his quest log, which is mostly garbled code except for one clear objective.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["garbled code", "quest log", "clear objective"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "transition_out_text": "He looks toward the dark trees of the Whispering Woods, knowing his life depends on what's inside.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["dark trees", "forest entrance", "determined look"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:1"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Math of Murder-Hoboing",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Grind is Real",
          "end_condition": "Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the Whispering Woods and encounters low-level slimes.",
              "location_start_label": "Forest Edge",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "The edge of the Whispering Woods.",
              "location_end": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The air grows cold and damp as Artie steps under the canopy of the Whispering Woods.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["cold air", "damp soil", "whispering leaves"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:10",
              "transition_out_text": "A group of green slimes bounces toward him, their movements rhythmic and predictable.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["green slimes", "bouncing sound", "predictable path"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie tries to fight normally but finds his damage is too inconsistent.",
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "location_end": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie swings at the lead slime, his sword passing through it with a pathetic 'thwip' sound.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sword swing", "thwip sound", "zero damage"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_out_text": "He realizes he needs to find another glitch point to do any real damage.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glitch point search", "frustrated sigh", "slime bounce"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie kills a slime on a 'loot-boundary' line, causing it to drop infinite items.",
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "location_end": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie backs up against a strange shimmering line in the air and strikes the slime just as it crosses it.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shimmering line", "boundary strike", "slime pop"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Instead of one pile of loot, a fountain of items begins to erupt from the ground.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["loot fountain", "erupting items", "infinite drops"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie triggers a recursive loot loop in the Whispering Woods.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Looting the World Dry",
          "end_condition": "The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The loot loop begins to lag the local area, freezing monsters in place.",
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "location_end": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The pile of slime-gel and rusty daggers grows so large that the nearby trees start to flicker.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["item pile", "flickering trees", "system lag"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_out_text": "A nearby wolf monster freezes mid-leap, suspended in the air by the processing load.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["frozen wolf", "mid-leap", "lag spike"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie walks through the frozen forest, 'harvesting' the stationary mobs.",
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Dungeon Depths",
              "location_start": "The dense, foggy forest interior.",
              "location_end": "The heart of the forest dungeon.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie realizes he can just walk up to the frozen monsters and tap them for loot.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["frozen monsters", "easy harvest", "loot collection"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_out_text": "He reaches the center of the woods, where the dungeon boss is stuck in a T-pose.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["dungeon center", "t-posing boss", "silent forest"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie loots the boss and every container in the zone, leaving it a void.",
              "location_start_label": "Dungeon Depths",
              "location_end_label": "Dungeon Depths",
              "location_start": "The heart of the forest dungeon.",
              "location_end": "The heart of the forest dungeon.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "With a single poke, the T-posing boss shatters, dropping the final shards Artie needs.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["boss poke", "shattering data", "final shards"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_out_text": "The forest is now eerily empty, not a single blade of grass or pebble remaining.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["empty forest", "void-like zone", "total loot"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Market Crash",
          "end_condition": "Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie returns to the nearby town and sells his mountain of trash loot.",
              "location_start_label": "Dungeon Depths",
              "location_end_label": "Town Square",
              "location_start": "The heart of the forest dungeon.",
              "location_end": "The bustling market of the local town.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie staggers into town, his inventory bags bulging with more items than should be physically possible.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["town entrance", "bulging bags", "market noise"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_out_text": "The local merchant's eyes widen as Artie dumps a thousand slime-gels onto the counter.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["merchant shock", "loot dump", "gold clinking"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The Guild arrives to find the Whispering Woods 'deleted'.",
              "location_start_label": "Town Square",
              "location_end_label": "Town Square",
              "location_start": "The bustling market of the local town.",
              "location_end": "The bustling market of the local town.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A group of high-level adventurers gallops past Artie, heading toward the forest with worried expressions.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["galloping horses", "guild capes", "worried faces"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie watches from the shadows as they realize their primary training ground is gone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["shadowy watch", "guild confusion", "deleted zone"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie observes the Adventurers' Guild arriving to investigate the 'looted' dungeon.",
              "hands_off_to": "3:1"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "title": "Grand Theft Artifact",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Stability Tax",
          "end_condition": "Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie's stability drops to 5%, causing his UI to glitch violently.",
              "location_start_label": "Town Square",
              "location_end_label": "Town Square",
              "location_start": "The bustling market of the local town.",
              "location_end": "The bustling market of the local town.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie tries to check his gold balance, but the numbers turn into screaming skulls.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["screaming skulls", "glitched UI", "static noise"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "transition_out_text": "He realizes he needs a massive power source to keep his character from deleting itself.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stability warning", "looming deletion", "desperate search"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie bribes a local thief for information on the 'Cooldown Reset' gem.",
              "location_start_label": "Town Square",
              "location_end_label": "Shady Alley",
              "location_start": "The bustling market of the local town.",
              "location_end": "A dark, narrow alleyway.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie follows a hooded figure into a narrow alley where the sun doesn't reach.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["hooded figure", "narrow alley", "shadowy deal"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",
              "transition_out_text": "The thief points toward the massive stone citadel in the center of the city.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stone citadel", "thief's finger", "vault location"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie reaches the vault's exterior and identifies the security wards.",
              "location_start_label": "Shady Alley",
              "location_end_label": "City Citadel",
              "location_start": "A dark, narrow alleyway.",
              "location_end": "The heavily guarded entrance to the city's vault.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "The citadel looms over Artie, its walls covered in glowing blue security runes.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["looming citadel", "security runes", "guarded gate"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie spots a flickering rune that looks exactly like the glitch point on the Golem.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flickering rune", "security flaw", "vault entrance"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie locates the 'Cooldown Reset' gem within the city's high-security vault.",
              "hands_off_to": "3:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Vault Heist",
          "end_condition": "Artie successfully acquires the Cooldown Reset gem.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie 'clips' through the first security gate by exploiting a collision bug.",
              "location_start_label": "City Citadel",
              "location_end_label": "Vault Corridor",
              "location_start": "The heavily guarded entrance to the city's vault.",
              "location_end": "A narrow, magically lit corridor.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks straight into the corner of the gate, vibrating his character back and forth.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["corner vibrating", "collision bug", "gate clipping"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:3",
              "transition_out_text": "With a sickening pop, he lands on the other side of the stone wall.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sickening pop", "other side", "vault interior"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie bypasses the laser grid by turning his graphics settings to 'Low'.",
              "location_start_label": "Vault Corridor",
              "location_end_label": "Inner Vault",
              "location_start": "A narrow, magically lit corridor.",
              "location_end": "The main treasure chamber.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "A grid of lethal red lasers blocks the path, but Artie opens his settings menu.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["laser grid", "settings menu", "low graphics"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:4",
              "transition_out_text": "The lasers disappear as his UI fails to render them, allowing him to walk right through.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["invisible lasers", "render failure", "safe passage"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie fights the Vault Guardian by baiting it into a bottomless pit glitch.",
              "location_start_label": "Inner Vault",
              "location_end_label": "Inner Vault",
              "location_start": "The main treasure chamber.",
              "location_end": "The main treasure chamber.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "A massive mechanical spider drops from the ceiling, its legs clicking against the gold coins.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["mechanical spider", "clicking legs", "gold coins"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:5",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stands over a hole in the floor that leads to an infinite black void.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["infinite void", "floor hole", "guardian bait"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie grabs the gem just as the Guardian falls into the void.",
              "location_start_label": "Inner Vault",
              "location_end_label": "Inner Vault",
              "location_start": "The main treasure chamber.",
              "location_end": "The main treasure chamber.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
